queries.sql: SELECT `t`.*, `c`.`name` as `customer_name`, `c`.`whatsapp_number`, `sc`.`name` as `category_name`, `s`.`name` as `assigned_name` FROM `tickets` `t` LEFT JOIN `customers` `c` ON `c`.`id` = `t`.`customer_id` LEFT JOIN `service_categories` `sc` ON `sc`.`id` = `t`.`service_category_id` LEFT JOIN `staff` `s` ON `s`.`id` = `t`.`assigned_staff_id` ORDER BY CASE t.priority WHEN "high" THEN 1 WHEN "medium" THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, `t`.`created_at` DESC LIMIT 20
